quantifier: Every ACTUAL_PERSISTENT, terminal-first-surviving LOW_PROPER_HEIGHT state S with 2<=h(S)<p(S), k(S)>1, and k_perp(S)>1, in either m(S)=3 with 5 not dividing D_star(S), or m(S)>3.

definitions.k_perp: product q^v_q(k) over prime q dividing k with q not dividing h
definitions.q_perp: the least prime q such that q divides k and q does not divide h; equivalently the least prime divisor of k_perp

whole_domain_existence_statement: k_perp>1 implies that k_perp has a least prime divisor q_perp; by the defining support restriction, q_perp divides k and does not divide h.
